targets.rawSql: SELECT key AS "Data Type", updated_at AS "Last Updated", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - updated_at)) / 60) AS "Age (min)" FROM ingestion_state ORDER BY key

SELECT DISTINCT ON (step) step AS "Step", started_at AS "Last Run", duration_ms AS "Duration (ms)", rows_affected AS "Rows", CASE WHEN success THEN '✓' ELSE '✗' END AS "Status" FROM cron_runs ORDER BY step, started_at DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN success THEN 'Success' ELSE 'Failed' END AS "Result", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM cron_runs WHERE started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY success

SELECT step AS "Step", started_at AS "Time", duration_ms AS "Duration (ms)", LEFT(error_message, 200) AS "Error" FROM cron_runs WHERE NOT success AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50
